title: Head of Finance, Brazil
description:
CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries. Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows.

We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.

This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional/global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic & Financial Leadership
  • Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil’s dynamic economic and regulatory environment.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long‑range planning processes for Brazil.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.
  • Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.
Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness
  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).
  • Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD/ECF), and other regulatory submissions.
  • Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high/medium/low risk) within established timelines.
  • Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve “audit-ready, always” standards.
  • Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.
Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management
  • Own end‑to‑end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).
  • Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.
  • Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.
  • Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.
Performance Management & Business Partnering
  • Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.
  • Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost‑to‑serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitability
Internal Controls, Governance & Risk Management
  • Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.
  • Lead governance of Fixed‑asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3PL and distributor consignment)
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.

epilot is building a SaaS product to sell complex products online, focusing on solving ecommerce in the rapidly transforming energy market. Our mission: Make selling complex energy products as easy as selling a pair of shoes online.

As Software Engineer at epilot you will be a driving force in shaping this mission. What makes working as a Software Engineer at epilot so special? Our unique engineering culture is defined by a few core engineering principles.

Among others, you can expect freedom and responsibility because we hire smart people who we can trust. We operate by principles and expect our teams to cultivate a strategic mindset.

We believe in ownership: you build it, you run it . We subscribe to this core principle of the DevOps movement. There is no dedicated Ops team who you can pass on the responsibility to take your code and make sure it runs reliably and scales to customers’ needs.

You should always show, don’t tell : Deliver working software early and frequently. We believe in the basic Agile principle of “Release early and release often”. This approach helps us manage risk and make better decisions by creating fast feedback loops between ourselves and our users.

We design software API First. Before we write a single line of code, we design the APIs of a service in a way that any other team, whether internal to epilot or external, can use the APIs interface with our service without prior knowledge.

Does this sound like an environment you want to work in? Then you could bet the right person to be an engineer at epilot!

Check out our promise to you: promise.epilot.cloud

Main requirements

What you bring

We’re looking for a Product-Minded Engineer who resonates with our values and has the following skills and mindset:

  • Product Thinking : You care about delivering value to customers and users, not just writing code.
  • Technical Expertise :
    • Hands-on experience with React or other JavaScript frameworks.
    • Knowledge of RESTful APIs or GraphQL .

  • Os serviços na Guanabara Diesel devem sempre ser realizados com a máxima qualidade, buscando sempre garantir ao Cliente a confiança em seus produtos, respeitando o meio ambiente, valorizando o Colaborador e assegurando aos Acionistas a garantia do retorno esperado.

  • A Guanabara Diesel busca satisfazer os desejos e expectativas do Cliente oferecendo a eles a máxima excelência em produtos e serviços.
  • Profissionalismo.
  • Todos os Colaboradores da Guanabara Diesel exercem suas atividades de forma correta, planejada e com excelência técnica.

Qualificações

  • Capacidade de gerenciamento de prazos, tarefas e pessoas;

Nascemos da moda, mas nossa história nunca foi apenas sobre roupa. Criados com um propósito, somos movidos por coragem, inovação e coração. Aqui, nossa essência tem voz, o orgulho pulsa e a mente está sempre aberta. Valorizamos quem soma com respeito, provoca com empatia e acredita que é o diferente que transforma, porque é na diversidade que a gente se fortalece.

Feita por gente boa e do bem , a AR&CO é o ecossistema das marcas masculinas mais desejadas, inovadoras e conscientes — Reserva, Reserva Mini, Reserva Go, Ink, Oficina e Foxton — conectadas pelo propósito de cuidar, emocionar e surpreender as pessoas todos os dias .

Temos orgulho do que construímos :de uma loja de 33m² à integração, como unidade de negócio, do maior grupo de moda da América Latina: Azzas 2154 . De norte a sul do Brasil, somos a expressão de milhares de pessoas, no varejo e na logística, na indústria e nos escritórios.

AR&CO: Feita por gente boa e do bem .

  • Formação acadêmica em Tecnologia, Engenharias, Economia ou similares (exatas).
  • Inglês Avançado (mas não é condicional).
  • Mão na massa em plataformas de mídia (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Programática, Afiliados, Retail Media, etc).
  • Domínio em GA4, AppsFlyer, Looker Stúdio, PowerBI, integrações nativas, etc.
  • Conhecimento prático de SQL básico e ETL leve é um plus.
  • Organização e disciplina operacional.
  • Boa comunicação com áreas parceiras.

Buscamos uma pessoa especialista em Martech e Performance (Mídias Pagas) para liderar nossa operação de aquisição e retenção com stack de marketing, automações e growth.

A posição centraliza tanto o planejamento e execução de mídia quanto a orquestração do ecossistema martech (CDP/CRM, tracking, automações, integrações e dados).

Foco

operação tática e liderança de squad pequeno, garantindo a excelência operacional e a evolução de projetos estratégicos. Perfil de liderança e execução mão na massa são essenciais.

Responsabilidades do cargo

  • Planejamento e execução de campanhas full-funnel (awareness → consideration → conversion → retention), inclusive incrementality tests.
  • Modelagem de metas de performance e budget pacing por canal, público e criativo; otimização por CAC/CPA, ROAS, LTV/CAC, margem.
  • Operação de audiências: first-party data, lookalikes, remarketing, suppression lists, RFM, propensity models.
  • Rotina de experimentação: testes de criativo, bid strategies, landing pages, ofertas, jornadas e triggers.
  • Relatórios e dashboards (ex.: Data Studio/Looker, Power BI): visão executiva e operacional, com análise de causa raiz.
  • Parceria com Conteúdo/Criação, Produto, Vendas e BI para orquestrar jornadas e atribuição.
  • Acelerar crescimento com eficiência de CAC, ROAS e LTV, garantindo mensuração ponta-a-ponta, governança de dados e escala previsível de mídia (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Programática, Afiliados, Retail Media).
  • Montar e otimizar campanhas diariamente; gerir contas, budgets e pacing.
  • Construir e manter dashboards operacionais e rotinas de reporting semanal.
  • Rodar roadmap de experimentos (A/B e multivariados) e documentar aprendizados.

Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Operational Leadership & Management

  • Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Nutricionista.

Local de Trabalho: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Carga Horária: 30H semanais

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Descrição da vaga

Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote

Graphic Communications (a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at

As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.

Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer‑reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen‑sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re‑route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.

Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front‑end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate‑related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET‑based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Self‑starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands‑on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.

Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands‑on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS).

Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião-dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Realizar atendimento na Estratégia Saúde da Família, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e protocolos existentes. Realizar assistência à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual, coletiva e incluindo ações no domicilio. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Desejável experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Médico.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Occupational Health & Safety Physician
description:
RINA is currently recruiting for a Occupational Health & Safety Physician to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the RINA Consulting QOHSE Division.

Mission

As part of the SESMT (Specialized Service in Safety Engineering and Occupational Medicine), the Occupational Physician plays a key role in promoting health and safety within the organization. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

  1. 1. Occupational Health Program Management
    • Coordinate the PCMSO (Occupational Health Medical Control Program), ensuring its proper implementation.
    • Actively participate in the activities of the CIPA (Internal Commission for Accident Prevention), ensuring compliance with Regulatory Standards in the workplace.
  2. 2. Medical Examinations and Health Surveillance
    • Conduct pre-employment, periodic, and termination medical examinations.
    • Diagnose and monitor occupational diseases, and provide timely medical intervention in emergency situations.
  3. 3. Emergency and Clinical Care
    • Deliver emergency medical care when required in the workplace.
  4. 4. Collaboration and Risk Management
    • Collaborate with HSE teams to identify and control occupational risks.
  5. 5. Health Promotion and Prevention
    • Promote accident and illness prevention through training and awareness initiatives for employees and stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Medicine in mandatory, along with an active CRM.
  • In-depth knowledge of national and international occupational health and safety regulations.
  • Experience in managing health surveillance programs and diagnosing occupational illnesses.
  • Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to risk management.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with digital tools for health data management and reporting.

Additional Information

  • Office located in Centro (RJ).
  • Hybrid work regime (after first period 100% on site).
  • All of our positions are also available to people with disabilities (PwD / PCD).
  • ADDRESS THE WAY - Have a big picture of different situations and reinterpret it in a perspective way
  • BUILD NETWORK - Forge trust relationships, across departments, and outside the organization
  • CLIENT INTIMACY - Embrace internal and external client needs, expectations and requirements to ensure maximum satisfaction
  • EARN TRUST - Take everyone's opinion into account and remain open to diversity
  • MAKE EFFECTIVE DECISIONS - Structure activities according to priorities, actions, resources and constraint
  • MANAGE EMOTIONS - Recognise one's and other's emotions and express and regulate one's reactions
  • PIONEER CHANGE - Actively embrace change and benefit from the new circumstances
  • THINK FORWARD - Capitalise on experiences and translate them into action plans for the future

Main responsibilities

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Construir e manter pipelines completos de treinamento, versionamento, testes e deploy de modelos de ML
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção
  • Gerenciar ambientes, contêineres, GPUs, escalabilidade e orquestração de recursos
  • Atuar em parceria com Cientistas de IA para transformar experimentos em soluções produtivas
  • Garantir observabilidade dos modelos, monitorando drift, performance, custo, logs e métricas
  • Criar infraestrutura de experimentação e padronizar fluxos de desenvolvimento de IA
  • Suportar segurança, governança e boas práticas na gestão do ciclo de vida dos modelos

We recognize that our people are key to helping us to achieve our vision, so we have fostered a culture that encourages, supports and celebrates diversity of thought. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we operate in.

Coordenador (a) de Manutenção Elétrica - Aciaria | Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Gerdau Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Coordenador (a) de Manutenção Elétrica - Aciaria | Rio de Janeiro/RJ role at Gerdau .

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador (a) de Manutenção Elétrica para atuar na Aciaria, garantindo a segurança das pessoas e a confiabilidade dos equipamentos. Se você tem experiência em liderança e gestão de manutenção elétrica, essa oportunidade pode ser ideal para você!

O que você vai fazer por aqui:

  • Coordenar a manutenção elétrica da Aciaria, assegurando o cumprimento das normas técnicas e de segurança (NRs);
  • Liderar equipes de manutenção, planejando e controlando atividades corretivas, preventivas e preditivas;
  • Gestão de indicadores como MTBF, MTTR e disponibilidade, além de controle de custos e backlog;
  • Desenvolvimento de equipe por meio de treinamentos e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Interface com Operação, PCM e Engenharia, promovendo melhorias contínuas e modernização dos ativos elétricos e sistemas de automação;
  • Atuação em grandes paradas de manutenção.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em manutenção elétrica industrial preferencialmente em siderurgia ou indústria metalmecânica;
  • Conhecimento avançado em sistemas de alta tensão;
  • Familiaridade com automação industrial e projetos de modernização;
  • Habilidade para gestão de indicadores e metodologias de manutenção;
  • Desejável vivência em Aciaria.

Programas de Benefícios da Gerdau

  • Programa de Benefícios flexíveis, para escolher seus benefícios, selecionando aqueles que melhor se adequam à sua realidade. Tudo em uma plataforma moderna, simples e intuitiva.

description:
Quem somos

A Longitude é uma consultoria internacional independente de design e engenharia , especializada em projetos nos setores de energia, marítimo, naval, offshore e renováveis . Parte do ABL Group , atuamos globalmente apoiando clientes ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida de ativos complexos, sempre com foco em segurança, excelência técnica, inovação e sustentabilidade .

Com uma atuação integrada globalmente, a Longitude conta também com um time no Brasil , que trabalha de forma colaborativa com equipes internacionais, conectando expertise local ao know-how global do grupo.

Nossa missão, visão e valores

? Missão
Entregar soluções de engenharia confiáveis e eficientes, apoiando nossos clientes na execução de projetos complexos com alto padrão técnico e segurança.

?️ Visão
Ser referência global em engenharia marítima e offshore, reconhecida pela qualidade, inovação e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

? Valores

  • Safety first – segurança sempre em primeiro lugar
  • Technical excellence – qualidade e precisão técnica
  • Collaboration – trabalho em equipe e relações de confiança
  • Innovation – melhoria contínua e soluções inteligentes
  • Integrity & transparency – ética, clareza e responsabilidade

Sobre a vaga

Você atuará como Engineering Job Leader da disciplina Elétrica , sendo o responsável técnico direto pelo desenvolvimento, coordenação e qualidade das entregas de engenharia elétrica em projetos offshore .

Além da atuação nos projetos locais, o profissional interagirá ativamente com projetos da Longitude ao redor do mundo , colaborando com equipes globais no compartilhamento de experiências, conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas , bem como prestando suporte técnico a projetos internacionais , fortalecendo a excelência técnica e a padronização global da disciplina elétrica.

Principais Responsabilidades

⚡ Liderar tecnicamente a disciplina elétrica , definindo escopo, prioridades, estratégias de execução e padrões técnicos dos projetos.

? Desenvolver, revisar e aprovar documentos e estudos elétricos , incluindo Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) , listas de carga, estudos de curto-circuito, arco elétrico, coordenação e harmônicos .

✅ Revisar, validar e aprovar tecnicamente os entregáveis elétricos produzidos por equipes internas ou empresas subcontratadas, atuando como autoridade técnica da disciplina .

? Garantir a conformidade com normas técnicas , regulamentos aplicáveis e requisitos de sociedades classificadoras (ABS, DNV, BV, entre outras).

? Gerenciar interfaces técnicas com outras disciplinas (Processo, Instrumentação, Naval, Estrutural, Automação), assegurando integração e consistência do projeto.

? Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto ao cliente , participando de reuniões técnicas, análises críticas e tomada de decisões.

? Colaborar com equipes globais da Longitude , apoiando projetos internacionais e promovendo padronização, melhoria contínua e compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico .

Requisitos

? Formação Acadêmica
Graduação completa em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.

⚡ Experiência Profissional
Experiência sólida em engenharia elétrica aplicada a projetos offshore , preferencialmente em FPSOs e plataformas de produção e experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica ou líder técnico da disciplina elétrica .

? Conhecimentos Técnicos
Conhecimento aprofundado de normas técnicas internacionais (IEC, IEEE, API, NORSOK) e requisitos de sociedades classificadoras.

? Ferramentas e Sistemas
Experiência com softwares de estudos elétricos (ex.: ETAP, SKM, PowerFactory ou similares).

? Idiomas
Inglês fluente (obrigatório), com capacidade de comunicação técnica em ambiente internacional.

✈️ Disponibilidade
Disponibilidade para viagens e embarques eventuais , reuniões presenciais e suporte técnico a projetos onshore e offshore.

Diferenciais

⭐ Experiência em projetos internacionais ou atuação em ambientes multiculturais.
⭐ Vivência com FPSOs e unidades de produção offshore.
⭐ Conhecimento avançado emsegurança elétrica , estudos de arco elétrico e classificação de áreas.

O que oferecemos para você

? VA, VR e VT pagos no Cartão Flash com flexibilidade de uso.
? Plano de saúde e odontológico extensíveis a dependentes sem desconto .
? Modelo híbrido de trabalho e horário flexível .
? Plano de carreira estruturado , com possibilidade de promoção a cada 6 meses , conforme avaliação de desempenho.
?️ Seguro de vida .
? Interface constante com times internacionais , promovendo trocas globais de conhecimento.
? Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) , com possibilidade de custeio de cursos e certificações pela empresa .
? Acesso gratuito à ABL Academy , com amplo portfólio de cursos técnicos.
?️ Aulas gratuitas de inglês e espanhol , com professora no escritório.
?️ Wellhub (Gympass) para saúde física e bem-estar.
? Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos .
? Ambiente técnico, colaborativo e internacional, com foco em excelência e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Além disso, poderá fazer parte de um Clube de Benefícios bem diferenciado.

description:

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting ourVI-P Guide, which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role, with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “ moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact : You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities : Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking : Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth : Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

  • You own the outcome : You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame.
  • You level up fast : You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10.
  • You close the loop : You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact.
  • You stay cool under pressure : Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team : You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have :

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

Career Switchers

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First : All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours : Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave : There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget : You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited toyourwork setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech : New joiners receive abudget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

title: Roaming IREG Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services. We’re looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21).
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners such as carriers and service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM.
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a.
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it.
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols.
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions.
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape.

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

JOB DESCRIPTION

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

Ser diverso é ser Super!

Esta oportunidade também está publicada no portal global de vagas da SHV Energy e faz parte do nosso compromisso de atrair talentos que compartilham dos nossos valores, independente da localização.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS

Objetivo do Cargo

A posição de Especialista Tributário tem como objetivo liderar tecnicamente as estratégias de compliance e defesa tributária da empresa, com foco em tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL), atuando de forma proativa na gestão de riscos, na condução de processos de contencioso administrativo, interpretação e normatização de legislação federal e na identificação de oportunidades fiscais. Este profissional será referência técnica na área, com papel consultivo e estratégico junto às demais áreas da empresa e escritórios externos.

Responsabilidades do Cargo

  • Liderar tecnicamente a apuração e revisão dos tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL)
  • Coordenar métodos de revisão de obrigações acessórias federais (ECF, ECD, EFD-Contribuições, DCTFWeb, PER/DCOMP, REINF, entre outras) atuando ocasionalmente na sua elaboração
  • Atuar diretamente na condução de processos administrativos tributários, elaborando defesas, recursos e acompanhando julgamentos e fiscalizações em geral

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project ( to help build the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and AI capabilities work hand in hand. As an AI Agent Assistant, you'll collaborate with large language models (LLMs) that handle repetitive tasks, while you bring the nuance, judgment, and creativity required to deliver high‑quality results. In this role, you won't just review what AI produces — you'll work alongside it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real‑world application. Your day‑to‑day may range from fact‑checking a scientific claim to curating a dataset, conducting market research, or refining sales leads. This flexible, part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in research, editing, analysis, or related fields who are excited by the possibilities of human‑AI collaboration. Your contributions will directly influence how AI systems learn, evolve, and support industries worldwide.

This is a freelance role for a project, and your typical tasks may include:

  • Your mission - deliver well‑reasoned, accurate, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.
  • Conduct thorough web research to verify information and collect supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with large language models (LLMs) and internal tools, using them as copilots to complete complex tasks.
  • Design and refine prompts to guide AI toward higher‑quality results.
  • Apply best practices for working with LLMs, understanding both their strengths and limitations.

title: SME – Methane & OGMP (Oil & Gas, South America)
description:
About Envana

Envana is a sustainability technology and consulting company helping energy and industrial organizations measure, manage, and reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Our software platform delivers the data accuracy and transparency required for robust emissions measurement and reporting, while our consulting team provides the technical and strategic expertise to turn data into action.

Together, we support clients in building credible decarbonisation pathways, strengthening methane management programs, meeting evolving regulatory and voluntary reporting requirements (including OGMP 2.0 ), and achieving measurable emissions reductions.

At Envana, our people are our greatest strength. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture built on high support and high challenge, where curiosity is encouraged, innovation is rewarded, and individuals are empowered to take ownership of meaningful work. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and want to contribute to solving one of the world’s most critical climate challenges, Envana is the place to make an impact.

About the Opportunity

Envana is expanding its Sustainability and Decarbonisation practice in South America and is seeking an experienced SME – Methane & OGMP (Oil & Gas) to support and lead client engagements across the region.

This role focuses on helping oil & gas and energy-sector clients improve the accuracy of their greenhouse gas inventories, design and implement methane measurement and mitigation programs, and align with OGMP 2.0 , MRV best practices, and international reporting frameworks.

As an experienced SME, you will work closely with operators, technical teams, and sustainability leaders to move beyond emissions reporting toward measurement-informed emissions management and abatement . The role combines deep technical expertise in methane and GHG accounting with client-facing advisory, data integration, and strategic decarbonisation support.

This position offers an opportunity to play a key role in shaping Envana’s advisory presence in South America and supporting regional operators as methane regulation, transparency, and performance expectations continue to evolve.

This role is open to candidates based anywhere in South America.

Key Responsibilities

Client Delivery & Technical Leadership

  • Lead consulting engagements focused on methane quantification, MRV, and OGMP 2.0 alignment for oil & gas and energy-sector clients.
  • Support the development of measurement-informed GHG inventories , including reconciliation of bottom-up and top-down methane estimates.
  • Design and support methane mitigation and abatement programs, including source identification, prioritisation, and performance tracking.
  • Advise clients on improving emissions data quality, assurance readiness, and alignment with international frameworks (OGMP 2.0, GHG Protocol, IPCC).
  • Translate complex technical emissions data into clear, actionable insights for technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Provide technical review and quality assurance across deliverables to ensure analytical rigour and consistency.
  • Work closely with Envana’s software platform to integrate consulting insights into emissions measurement, reporting, and analytics tools.
  • Support proposal development and client pitches related to methane management, OGMP 2.0, and emissions strategy.
  • Build trusted relationships with regional operators, consultants, and partners across South America.
  • Identify emerging opportunities related to methane regulation, voluntary initiatives, and performance-based reporting.
  • Contribute to Envana’s growth strategy in South America by helping position the firm as a trusted partner in methane and emissions management.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge development around methane quantification, OGMP 2.0 implementation, and MRV best practices.
  • Contribute to thought leadership (presentations, technical notes, webinars) related to methane management and data-driven decarbonisation.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 6–10 years of experience in GHG accounting, methane quantification, MRV, or oil & gas sustainability consulting .
  • Demonstrated experience with OGMP 2.0 , methane inventories, emissions validation, or related reporting frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of GHG Protocol , IPCC methodologies, and measurement-based emissions approaches.
  • Experience working with upstream oil & gas, LNG, or energy-sector clients.
  • Proven ability to lead or significantly contribute to client engagements in a consulting or advisory environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Fluency in English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese strongly preferred .
  • Degree in engineering, environmental science, sustainability, or a related field; postgraduate qualification is a plus.

Why Join Envana

  • Play a key role in expanding Envana’s advisory presence in South America .
  • Work on some of the most pressing challenges in methane management and decarbonisation.
  • Combine technical advisory work with cutting‑edge emissions measurement technology.
  • Join a purpose‑driven, high‑growth company delivering measurable climate impact.

title: Inspection Supervisor - Brazil (#622)
description:
Our Core Values are at the heart of who we are, and everything we do….

People.

Planet.

Product.

Motive Offshore Group specialises in the design, manufacture, rental, and inspection of marine and lifting equipment and are committed to delivering sustainable, innovative and multisector solutions and we require highly skilled individuals, like you, to come and be part of our journey.

We have many exciting opportunities globally as we rapidly expand our reach and capabilities, in particular with the low carbon and energy transition areas. We aim to assist our clients and suppliers to join us as we move in to the more sustainable world.

Most importantly, our People are our most valuable asset here at the Motive Offshore Group and we encourage an inclusive, innovative and collaborative workplace that allows our employees & candidates to positively work towards their career potential.

About the role:

Hours: Full-time

The Inspection Supervisor will be responsible for leading and supervising all inspection, NDT, and rope access activities. The role includes ensuring full compliance with IRATA Level III rigging and safety requirements. Duties involve planning, coordinating, and carrying out routine and periodic surveys using the full range of NDT methods and inspection equipment. Onsite training, mentoring, and performance oversight for Inspectors also form a key part of the position. Responsibilities further include undertaking all tasks associated with a Level III Rope Access Supervisor.

The position requires ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest technical standards. Additional responsibilities include supporting continuous improvement initiatives and contributing to the development and implementation of inspection procedures and best practices.

This role offers a rewarding opportunity to work in the offshore sector, with the chance to operate industry‑leading equipment and collaborate with skilled teams, while taking on a varied and challenging role that allows you to make a meaningful impact every day.

About the team:

As a part of our Brazil team, you’ll become part of a small, hardworking, and skilled team who work to a high standard and specification. Reporting to the Operations Manager for Brazil, you'll also become part of the wider America's team and be supported by our team of onshore and offshore personnel working alongside you, whose goal, much like your own, will be to enable a quick and safe turn‑around of equipment.

And you’ll be working alongside a committed and proud Motive team in the UK and globally that want to play their part in the growth of the business and support each other daily to create a positive, values driven and hard‑working professional environment.

Responsibilities:

People

  • Adopt and promote the Motive Offshore Group People Values and ensuring their use is embedded throughout.
  • Develop strong working relations with key stakeholders – clients, colleagues etc.
  • To be a positive ambassador for Motive Offshore Group Ltd.
  • To uphold the Motive Offshore Group People Values.

Planet

  • Lead by example in setting the highest possible standards in the promotion of People Values, HSEQ procedures and best practice, ensuring compliance to the Motive Offshore Group HSEQ Policy, procedures, standards and regulatory obligations.
  • Immediately report all accidents, incidents, near misses or environmental concerns.
  • Adhere to and participate in company‑wide sustainability policies, procedures and initiatives as they are developed to support our Net Zero objectives.

Product

  • To provide Rope Access supervision, advice and support.
  • To perform Rope Access activities.
  • Perform the role of Level III Rope Access Supervisor and carry out various rope access works such as NDT, structural installations, and removals, shot blasting and painting in a safe and efficient manner. Rig up and inspect rope access equipment prior to and during use.
  • Carry out routine surveys, inspections and load testing of Lifting equipment and their accessories and the immediate reporting of defects or concerns.
  • Maintain the compilation of all hours undertaken for rope access activities, report findings to rope access manager.
  • Mentor other Spooling and Inspection Rope Access Technicians.
  • Ensure all rope access equipment is maintained.
  • Attend rope access refresher and other associated training as required.
  • Where qualified, carry out visual and NDT examination of all types and construction of high‑performance wire rope.
  • Where qualified, carry out pressure lubrication of all types of high‑performance wire ropes in accordance with working procedures and COSHH Assessments.
  • Complete Daily Client Service Record, Rope Access forms in full, with accurate times and descriptions obtaining signed approval from the client where required.
  • Proper set up of equipment.
  • Use of Kinetic Software for the review, approval and production of good quality inspection reports ready to send to customers.
  • Travelling to worldwide destinations as and when required.

Required skills / knowledge:

  • Significant offshore experience.
  • Suitable NDT certification (SNT or PCN Level II).
  • IRATA Rope Access Level III.
  • Offshore certification.
  • Experience operating machinery.
  • Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team.
  • Ability to prioritise.
  • Strong organisation skills with a good ability to prioritise and work to deadlines.
  • Ability to cope with change in a busy working environment.

What we can offer you:

Working with Motive can take you places that you might not have thought possible. Every region we operate in, bring their own wonderful cultures & ways of working. And as a global business, you will become colleagues with people not only in the UK, but also in Taiwan, Singapore, the UAE, Norway, Brazil and in the US. You can look forward to becoming part of our people‑centred approach that sees us work closely together, supporting clients and projects in multiple countries across the world.

People are at the heart of everything we do and we’re incredibly proud of the development opportunities that many of our staff have benefitted from. Since we started in 2010, we’ve seen school leavers work their way to senior positions, people relocate to other parts of the world and countless colleagues develop skills, receive training and advance their technical knowledge to enhance their own career, which in turn helps us continuously improve as a business, an employer and carry out the services we have become renowned for. At Motive, we believe in growing together. We are One Team, One Motive, and your journey is part of our shared success.

How to Apply & what happens next:

You’re happy and ready to apply? Great, thank you.

You can apply by sending us a CV with any supporting documents telling us why you’d like to work with us at Motive Offshore Group.

We want to find great people and learn more about you as a person, ensuring we all have a positive recruitment journey. So please, tell us more about you, however you’d want.

Once we’ve reviewed your application, we’ll be back in touch as soon as possible to update you on the next stages of the process. If you have any questions about the role or want to chat about what life is like at Motive Offshore Group, email us at

Hempel is seeking an experienced and technically skilled Senior Coating Advisor to join our Technical Services team in Brazil within the marine segment. This role is responsible for providing technical advice and support to sales teams as well as conducting technical analyses of product configurations to determine customer‑specific pricing. Key responsibilities include preparing and conducting technical sales briefings for customers and company representatives researching customer technical specifications estimating the costs resources time and technical requirements for modifying configuring and installing products or solutions and evaluating sales proposals to ensure they are technically accurate and aligned with the organizations quality standards.

  • Fulfill assigned projects in accordance with the requirements of the Work Orders.

  • Keep all parties informed of work progress through Progress case of deviations or non-conformities notify the customer in writing provide recommendations for preventive/corrective actions and follow up on their implementation.
  • Monitor and control paint inventory for the project provide timely updates to front/back office sales and ensure proper implementation of paint consumption planning and procedures.
  • Conduct coating condition surveys onshore and offshore as required.

  • Manage complex and large‑scale projects effectively.

  • Ensure quality and timely reporting of all work activities.
  • Support the sales force regarding technical aspects of the company's products and services.
  • Complete all required reports with high quality and on time.
  • Utilize information tools efficiently in accordance with Hempels procedures.
  • Ensure all Technical Services staff equipment is used according to project procedures and specifications and that all equipment is calibrated and in good working condition.
  • Comply with training programs to acquire the necessary skills knowledge and behaviors.
  • Travel to project sites and prepare/distribute technical reports; travel accounts for approximately 80% of working time both domestically and internationally.
  • Conduct work safely and responsibly following Hempels HSE guidelines and the HSE procedures of each worksite.
  • Use all required personal protective equipment (PPE) and ensure it is always in good condition for the job.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Coating Advisor in a technical service role preferably within the marine segment.
  • Relevant certifications such as NACE FROSIO ABRACO or IARCOR.
  • Strong knowledge of the paint and coatings industry.
  • Technologically proficient and comfortable using digital reporting tools.
  • University degree in Chemistry or a related field is a plus.
  • Completion of required internal training as outlined in Hempels Group Training Policy.

Whats in it for you

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage for you and your immediate family (spouse and children)

A Light Conecta é prova de que inovação, agilidade e qualidade podem caminhar juntas . Em pouco tempo, tornou-se referência em prestação de serviços e continua crescendo com foco, excelência e brilho próprio.

É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde;
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‑generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes.

Tech context

You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on:

  • Frontend: Next.js/React , Typescript , Tailwind CSS

  • Quality: Unit, integration, and end‑to‑end tests; CI/CD .
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, Product Designer, and CEO.

What you will do

  • Build and ship end‑to‑end features across the Next.js frontend and Node/TypeScript backend.
  • Model and tune Postgres schemas; ensure secure authN/authZ and strong performance.
  • Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‑driven improvements).
  • Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows.
  • Make pragmatic early‑stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar.

What you will bring

  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality.
  • Strong production experience with Next.js/React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Tailwind & CSS mastery; responsive, accessible UI.
  • PostgreSQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers).
  • Integrations experience (third‑party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e).
  • Portfolio or links to shipped projects/code.

90‑day outcomes

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Lead at least one significant feature from design to production, used by real clinics or internal teams.
  • Improve a key part of the frontend experience (e.g., performance, usability, or design consistency) and document the standards for others.
  • Own part of the backend or data model, including at least one meaningful performance or reliability improvement.
  • Help define or refine testing and deployment practices so the team can ship faster and with more confidence.

Nice to have

  • Experience building voice‑controlled components / speech‑to‑text.
  • Experience interacting with AI models from the web app.

How we work

  • Remote within EST ±3 hours preferred ; open to other time zones if you can collaborate on US‑friendly hours.
  • Small, senior team with a strong bias toward action and ownership ;
  • Product‑led culture : engineers are closely involved in discovery, tradeoff discussions, and shaping the roadmap.

Hiring process

  • Coderpad Challenge (60 min)
  • Intro chat (45 min) – mutual fit and role context.
  • Technical deep‑dive & Live testing – discuss systems you’ve built; pair on a focused problem (no whiteboard trivia).
  • Team conversation – meet engineering + product leadership.
  • References & offer.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS

Confira as principais atividades do dia a dia para essa posição:

  • Estruturar e realizar, integração de novos funcionários e prestadores de serviços em todos os departamentos da empresa em assuntos relacionados a segurança do trabalho e controle de emergências;

  • Promover a realização de atividades de orientação, informação e conscientização dos trabalhadores para a prevenção de acidentes e doenças relacionadas ao trabalho;
